question: What Are the Control Valve Seat Leakage Classes?
body_html:
Control valve seat leakage classes under ANSI/FCI 70-2 set how much a fully closed valve may leak, in six grades from Class I (loosest) to Class VI (bubble tight):

ClassMaximum Leakage
INo shop test required
II0.5% of rated capacity
III0.1% of rated capacity
IV0.01% of rated capacity
V0.0005 mL/min of water per inch port per psi
VIBubbles per minute, soft seat

Example for Class V: Q = 0.0005 × 4 in × 500 psi = 1.0 mL/min.
